messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished: release/2026.03.22-mini (b3c4d) -> prod/us-west-1. Starting post-deploy smoke + synths (stagger 5%->15%).

Nikhil: Saw a quick p95 blip on /v1/reverse-proxy in us-west-1 from 220ms -> 640ms in the synth run. No 5xx spike but a few retries logged. cc @Sara

Sara: Any pattern on seq_len or client headers?

Nikhil: Synth sample shows mix, but the traces with retries share an initial cache miss and a subsequent model shard load.

Vik: Could be a model shard lazy-load impacting first requests. We have a prefill option we can toggle for canary pools. Suggest pinning route to previous modelvariant `revproxy-stable` while we enable prefill on canary.

Sara: Prefer pin+prefill over revert. Can someone run commands? I can apply prefill but need pin run by infra.

Vik: Running pin: `rbctl pin-route --region=us-west-1 --service=reverse-proxy --to=model:revproxy-stable --reason=\"postdeploy p95 tail\" --duration=45m`

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Vik at 1795550015.

Sara: Enabling prefill on canary pool: `rbctl pool-update --region=us-west-1 --pool=canary --set=prefill=true`

infra-bot: infra-bot: pool update applied at 1795550020. Prefill started; telemetry: https://internal.redwood/obs/1795550000

Nikhil: Quick A/B after pin+prefill: pinned p95=230ms, canary p95=250ms. No retries reproduced. Looks stable.

Sara: Good. Pausing rollout at 15% for 30m watch. Release notes: \"us-west-1: paused at 15% due to initial p95 blip; route pinned; prefill enabled; watch 30m.\"

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 15%. To continue: `deploy resume --percent=50`. To revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.20`.

Vik: I'll follow up with ML infra on eager shard warmup to avoid future cold-start tails. Standby. :mag:
